title: Decay Suppression Principle
description: Essential Criteria: The response must identify the conservation of electron-lepton and mu-lepton numbers as the principle responsible for decay suppression.

title: Crystal Arrangement
description: Important Criteria: The response should explain that the crystals should be placed face to face and perpendicular to the muon beam to detect the decay events.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state that for the decay mu+ -> e+ + gamma, the total energy E_e + E_gamma should equal m_mu.

title: Signal Distinction
description: Important Criteria: The response should describe how to distinguish between the two decay types based on the energy conservation differences.

title: Energy Comparison
description: Optional Criteria: The response may mention that for the four-body decay, E_e + E_gamma will be less than m_mu.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response should avoid common mistakes such as misidentifying the energy conservation conditions for the two decay types.
